evaluation_metadata.evaluator: FireSync calibration diagnostic (not an independent validation authority)
evaluation_metadata.evaluation_type: fixed-coefficient in-sample diagnostic + temporal holdout criteria check
evaluation_metadata.provenance_warning: The bundled archive is UNVERIFIED: raw NASA source files and download manifests are absent.

fixed_formula.note: Fixed exploratory assumption; no coefficient was fitted by this script.

limitations: Only 9 paired 1-km cells (at least 50 are required even to consider validation).
Reference variance is zero (every MODIS count is identical), so R² is undefined and reported as null.
The 0.294 scale factor is a fixed exploratory assumption from the literature, not a fitted Bangladesh coefficient.
Metrics are in-sample: no independent temporal or spatial holdout has been evaluated.
Agreement with a MODIS reference does not constitute direct ground-truth validation.
Cloud occlusion and differing overpass times affect diurnal fire detection.
Bow-tie pixel expansion in MODIS off-nadir tracks increases uncertainty at scan edges.
validation_criteria: Non-zero MODIS reference variance so R² is defined.
An independent temporal or spatial holdout that the model was not fitted on.
Finite slope uncertainty and holdout error metrics.
fixed_coefficient_diagnostic.interpretation: This scores one fixed formula on the same cells used to describe it. It cannot validate the model and never returns VALIDATED.

temporal_holdout.algorithm: Ordinary least squares with temporal holdout
limitations: Independent temporal holdout has not met the evidence requirements, so the model is not VALIDATED.
In-sample agreement must never be reported as independent validation.
validation_criteria: At least 30 paired cells in the training split.
At least 10 paired cells in the independent validation split.
Temporal separation: every validation date is later than every training date.
The validation reference (MODIS) has non-zero variance so R² is defined.
The fitted slope, intercept, R², MAE, RMSE and bias are all finite.
temporal_holdout.interpretation: VALIDATED requires all explicit criteria. Otherwise the result is INSUFFICIENT or EXPLORATORY and must not be reported as validation.

r_squared_definition: null: R² is undefined here (too few cells or zero reference variance). It is not zero.
